content:
Alex: Heads up — trying to run the release job for service-auth (v2.1.2) for tonight's change window (23:00 UTC) and deploy-bot returned an MFA/role error.
Alex: Error: "permission_denied: missing role release_deployer (MFA required)". Anyone oncall who can approve JIT?
deploy-bot: permission check failed for user "alex". To request temporary deploy rights run:
```bash
infra request-jit --user alex --role release_deployer --duration 3600 --reason "release v2.1.2 pin and canary"
```
Maria: @Liz can approve this? we'll need the audit ticket + release notes attached before granting.
Liz: I can sign off but prefer to limit to 1h and require 2FA. Also want a pinned rollback target in the ticket.
Kevin: Suggest pinning to v2.1.2-rc3 for the canary, and set rollback to v2.1.1 if we see errors >1%. Keep probing traffic at 10% for 15m.
Alex: Ack — I'll open the ticket and include rollout steps + health checks. Putting the canary plan and exact commit hashes in the ticket now.
Alex: Ticket created: infra/12345 — contains release notes, canary plan, rollback hash: abcdef123. Link: https://rwd.by/t/infra-12345
Liz: Reviewed ticket. I'm approving temporary role for Alex for 1 hour. Adding MFA requirement in the grant. Grant cmd run at 1767504600.
deploy-bot: Temporary role granted: user=alex role=release_deployer duration=3600 approved_by=Liz audit=https://rwd.by/audit/9876
Maria: Perfect. Alex, do the canary at 10% for 15m, monitor latency/error dashboards, call a rollback if >1% error or latency >200ms p50.
Alex: Starting canary now, pushing pinned image v2.1.2-rc3. Notifying #incidents if anything spikes.
Kevin: One more note — add a rollback note in the release notes: "if regressions, revert to v2.1.1 and notify infra@redwood.com". I'll watch tracing.
Alex: Canary healthy at 15m. No regressions. Proceeding to gradual rollout to 50%.
Liz: Thanks. Closing grant early (manually revoked) at 1767504660 — audit link updated.
deploy-bot: Temporary role revoked: user=alex revoked_by=Liz audit=https://rwd.by/audit/9880
Alex: Done with rollout. Will follow up with post-deploy checklist and final release notes update.
